clue.text: Conclusion of argument translated from Pushto

indicators.note: a translated text is turned into another form, so the letters of the language name are rearranged

blocks.note: Pushto is a variant name of the Pashto language, taken letter for letter

explanation.definitionFit: The final outcome or result of a discussion is its upshot, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Plain (bare) you'll find on chart to northward, divided by a river

clue.text: Rich in compost, much rotted, I planted
